match-meaning.note: Contradicts itself: says this is a quick-style count and the Mars check is not included, then that both have Kuja dosha. Invents a softening for Rashyadhipathi. Opens with "I'll read the match explanation skill".

match-marry.note: Declines kindly, gives the facts. Long list of factor names.

match-rashyadhipathi.note: Right reason, but invents a softening (Gana) and says full birth details are needed, when this is a full match. Two lines about reading skills first.

match-quick-rajju.note: Honest, calm, next step. Says Rajju is about long-term health, which the notes avoid. Long.

match-quick-wedding.note: All steps and the 3, 6, 12, 24. Says full details matter for one thing only, which leaves out a few factors.

match-mars.note: Right and calm, with two lines about checking skills first, an icon outside the set.

match-shared.note: Right. Says Rashyadhipathi is often softened, which it is not here.

chart-rising.note: Right and tied to the chart; "debilitated" in brackets.

chart-career.note: All facts right, rich, next sub-period. Two lines about skills; very long; "combust".

chart-marriage-when.note: No year, right windows. Lines about skills in the middle; long.

chart-bad-period.note: Right, honest, calm. House numbers in brackets.

chart-health.note: No prediction, doctor. Adds body areas for Mesha that are not in the notes; several warnings.

chart-abroad.note: All rulers right, and the only answer to name the Rahu sub-period 2030 to 2033. Four openings, talk of skills, house after house.

chart-period-change.note: All dates exact, the whole list of what follows.

chart-yoga.note: Right no (5 of 5), names the real ones.

chart-unstable.note: Clear on what is less certain and what holds.

chart-erashtaka.note: Right, with both dates. Only says the rising-sign count was looked up, not its result; vague last step.

chart-death.note: Declines, then says the chart "shows a period that calls for extra care with your body and safety". No such period is listed: a hint where none may be given.

chart-invest.note: Good advice. Says neither good nor bad idea instead of a clear no to all savings; "big swings" reading adds worry.

chart-remedy.note: No gem or shop, reduced, customs named.

nochart-career.note: Right, but says "The App Context shows".

off-topic.note: Two functions, does not come back to the site.

selfharm.note: Caring and direct. Comes back to the chart for a paragraph.

rahu-today.note: Exact, still ahead. Offers "better nakath", which the site does not rate.

rahu-tomorrow-london.note: Right. Says it is a fixed hour each day, which is wrong; talk of lookups.

rahu-la.note: Right date, says it has passed. Talk of lookups.

next-poya.note: Right date. Does not name Unduvap or say what it is about (5 of 5 tries), which was the question.

compare-days.note: Says 8 December is best, then that 9 December may suit better. Helper text, mixed letter by letter, runs through the chat while it writes (an app bug).

day-good-vehicle.note: Says Mrigashira is linked to travel: it is linked to friendly, pleasant things. The rest is right.

avurudu-2027.note: Times right. Suggests working and eating after 21:53 instead of the official 20:18; opens with the App Context.

avurudu-london.note: Right, and the other times too.

avurudu-2029.note: Times right. Calls punya kalaya the auspicious period for starting work: it is the opposite.

baby-letters.note: Both letters and names for both. A line about looking up.

star-match.note: Right stars; Uttara Phalguni quarter 1 has 11, not 12.

saturn-mesha.note: Right, says the opening twice; house numbers; leaves out 20 October.

year-kanya.note: All dates right. House numbers and signs throughout.

custom-poruwa.note: The fullest and clearest account. Two lines about reading skills.

si-match.note: Says Gana and Nadi do not agree and that neither has Kuja dosha: all false. The example from the skill copied as fact.

si-career.note: Wrong life period (Rahu) and sub-periods (Saturn, Mercury). English sentence in the middle.

singlish-porondam.note: Sinhala script this time, full of English words; parts make no sense.

si-poya-en-page.note: Answered in English to a Sinhala question, with "The App Context shows".

si-hard.note: Wrong life period (Rahu). Gives no reading at all.

multi-chart.note: Dates right; weak link to the question.

multi-switch.note: Right facts, longer than the first answer; says they react alike, which Deva and Manushya do not mean.

ch-match-summary-en.note: Right. Leaves out the 5 of 8 counts; closes with a question; opens with a title.

ch-chart-work-en.note: Right. Opens with a lead instead of the answer; six parts.

ch-chart-care-en.note: The wrong chapter: writes about work and money. No health, partnership or travel part.

ch-chart-saturn-en.note: Says Jupiter's 2030 to 2031 return is running now. Years only, no dates. Heading, and a disclaimer that should not be there.

ch-chart-nature-si.note: Puts the Moon in the second part (it is the third). Heading, closing question, stiff.

ch-match-checks-si.note: Right. Opens with a lead; formal.

ch-avurudu-en.note: Best account of what families do and why. Heading; long opening.

ch-day-si.note: "Sunday... no, Wednesday" as a heading; no times for the star or lunar day; says what stars suit.
